name: Repair
summary: Fault finding and repairs for AC units that aren't cooling like they should.
description: When an AC stops cooling, leaks water, trips the breaker or shows an error code, we find the actual cause before replacing anything. Our technicians test the electrical, refrigerant and airflow sides of the system, explain what they find, and quote clearly before starting work.
duration: 1 – 2 hours for most diagnoses; parts jobs may need a second visit
suitable_for: All AC types and major brands
includes: Diagnosis of cooling, noise, leakage and error-code issues
PCB, sensor, capacitor and fan motor replacement
Genuine spares sourced through our parts desk
signs: AC runs but the air isn't cold
Water dripping from the indoor unit
Breaker trips or the AC won't switch on
Error code or blinking lights on the display

options.name: Not cooling / low cooling
options.detail: Gas, compressor, coil and airflow checks

options.name: Water leakage
options.detail: Drain line, tray and installation slope fixes

options.name: Not starting / tripping
options.detail: Electrical, capacitor, PCB and wiring faults

options.name: Noise or error code
options.detail: Fan motor, bearings, sensors and fault codes

process.title: Diagnosis
process.text: We test electrical, refrigerant and airflow systems to find the real fault.

process.title: Clear quote
process.text: You get an explanation of the problem, parts needed and cost before any work.

process.title: Repair
process.text: We fix the fault using correctly rated, genuine spare parts.

process.title: Verification
process.text: Cooling, pressure and current are checked before we leave.

faqs.question: Is there a visit charge?
faqs.answer: A diagnosis charge applies for the visit. We tell you the amount when you book, and the work is quoted separately.

faqs.question: Do you repair inverter ACs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We repair inverter PCBs, sensors and BLDC compressors across major brands.
